title: A quotient of a strictly henselian local ring by a proper ideal is strictly henselian (Stacks 05WS for a strictly henselian ring)
statement: Let $(A,\mathfrak m,\kappa)$ be a strictly henselian local ring [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology] and let $I\subseteq\mathfrak m$ be an ideal. Then $A/I$ is a local ring with maximal ideal $\mathfrak m/I$ and residue field $\kappa$, and $A/I$ is strictly henselian: for every finite $A/I$-algebra $B$ every idempotent of $B/(\mathfrak m/I)B$ lifts uniquely to an idempotent of $B$, and $\kappa$ is separably closed.

source.place: Lemma 05WS (label lemma-quotient-strict-henselization), line 43703 ($R^{sh}/IR^{sh}$ is a strict henselization of $R/I$), applied as in etale-cohomology.tex Lemma 09ZC (line 14445) proof to a strictly henselian $R$ (so $R^{sh}=R$); direct route: a finite $A/I$-algebra $B$ is a finite $A$-algebra with $B/\mathfrak mB=B/(\mathfrak m/I)B$, so the idempotent lifting of Definition 04GE/04GF transfers
